Title: Check problem card placement and appearance

Step Action: Sign in as a care team member and navigate to PGI & Notes > View Closed/Voided/Dismissed PGIs.
Step Expected: The closed/voided/dismissed PGI view is displayed.

Step Action: Set the Status filter to Closed and click See History on a problem.
Step Expected: The Problem History modal displays a standalone white problem card above the search bar and history table.

Step Action: Compare the problem card placement and styling with the card in the Intervention History modal.
Step Expected: The card position and styling match the Intervention History modal.

Step Action: Close the modal and repeat using the Voided (from Open) filter and a voided problem.
Step Expected: The voided problem card appears in the same position and style above the search bar and history table.

Title: Check collapsed problem card content and current status

Step Action: From PGI & Notes > View Closed/Voided/Dismissed PGIs filter by Closed and open See History for a problem with known details and a Proposed Resolution Date.
Step Expected: The card is collapsed by default with a show more link. Created by and Created Date/Time and Patient Friendly Description are hidden.

Step Action: Compare the collapsed card with the selected problem's known details and the Open Problems card format.
Step Expected: The correct domain/category, priority, title, and individualized description appear. The Proposed line reads Proposed: [date] | Closed in the Open Problems card format.

Step Action: Close the modal and repeat for a problem selected using Voided (from Open).
Step Expected: The card is collapsed by default and displays the selected problem's correct details. The Proposed line reads Proposed: [date] | Voided.

Step Action: From PGI & Notes > View Closed/Voided/Dismissed PGIs filter by Closed and open See History for a problem without a Proposed Resolution Date.
Step Expected: The card displays Proposed: Not available | Closed.

Step Action: Close the modal and repeat using Voided (from Open) for a problem without a Proposed Resolution Date.
Step Expected: The card displays Proposed: Not available | Voided.

Title: Check problem card expand and collapse

Step Action: From PGI & Notes > View Closed/Voided/Dismissed PGIs filter by Closed and open a problem's See History. Click show more.
Step Expected: The card expands and the link changes to show less. Accurate Created by, Created Date/Time, and Patient Friendly Description appear using existing Open Problems formatting.

Step Action: Click show less.
Step Expected: The additional fields are hidden. Collapsed content remains visible and the link changes back to show more.

Step Action: Repeat the expand and collapse steps for a problem selected using Voided (from Open).
Step Expected: The same expand/collapse behavior and accurate additional details are displayed for the voided problem.

Title: Check selected problem details and collapsed state on reopening

Step Action: From PGI & Notes > View Closed/Voided/Dismissed PGIs filter by Closed and open problem A's See History. Expand the card and close the modal.
Step Expected: The expanded modal closes.

Step Action: Reopen problem A's history.
Step Expected: The card opens collapsed and the card and history show problem A's details.

Step Action: Close the modal and open problem B with different details under the same filter.
Step Expected: The card opens collapsed. Both card and history belong to problem B with no stale content from problem A.

Step Action: Close the modal and switch to Voided (from Open). Open problem C's history.
Step Expected: The card opens collapsed. Both card and history belong to problem C and the card status is Voided with no stale Closed status.

Title: Check status transition and reason appear only in history

Step Action: From PGI & Notes > View Closed/Voided/Dismissed PGIs filter by Closed and open history for a problem closed from In Progress with reason No longer applies. Inspect both card states and the table.
Step Expected: The card shows current status Closed without the previous status or transition or close reason. The history table records In Progress to Closed and Status Reason changing from blank to No longer applies using existing table presentation.

Step Action: Close the modal and filter by Voided (from Open). Open history for a problem voided from In Progress with reason Manual entry error. Inspect both card states and the table.
Step Expected: The card shows current status Voided without the previous status or transition or void reason. The history table records In Progress to Voided and Status Reason changing from blank to Manual entry error using existing table presentation.

Title: Check history search and sorting remain unchanged when toggling the card

Step Action: From PGI & Notes > View Closed/Voided/Dismissed PGIs filter by Closed and open history for a problem with known history entries.
Step Expected: The Change Date, Changed By, Field, and Change columns and all expected entries retain their existing values and formatting.

Step Action: Search for a value present in the history and then a value not present. Clear the search.
Step Expected: Matching records are shown for the matching search. Existing no-results behavior is retained for the unmatched search. Clearing search restores all records. The problem card remains visible.

Step Action: Exercise each currently sortable column in both supported directions.
Step Expected: Records sort as before without changing row data or card content.

Step Action: Apply a matching search and a supported sort order. Expand and collapse the problem card.
Step Expected: Search text, matching results, and sort order are preserved. Search and table remain usable.

Step Action: Repeat these checks for a problem selected using Voided (from Open).
Step Expected: History entries, search, sorting, and state preservation behave identically for the voided problem.

Title: Check long content and history scrolling and Close button

Step Action: From PGI & Notes > View Closed/Voided/Dismissed PGIs filter by Closed and open history for a problem with a long title, long descriptions, and extensive history.
Step Expected: The card follows existing Open Problems wrapping/truncation behavior without overlapping the search bar or history table.

Step Action: Expand and collapse the card and scroll through the long history.
Step Expected: Content remains readable in both states. Modal scrolling matches Intervention History behavior and the Close button remains accessible.

Step Action: Click Close.
Step Expected: The modal closes and returns to the underlying PGI view.

Step Action: Reopen the modal and expand the card. Scroll and click Close.
Step Expected: Close remains accessible and closes the expanded modal.

Step Action: Repeat these checks for a problem selected using Voided (from Open).
Step Expected: Long content, scrolling, and Close behave consistently for the voided problem.
